Alex Chen: Quick poll — if the office fridge were an LLM, what persona would it have? 😂
Priya Nair: Midwestern teacher who only answers with recommended snacks and passive advice. :canned_food: :apple:
Marco Diaz: 100% a brittle, overly helpful assistant that reminds you about expired yogurt at 11:59pm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jin Park: it would also silently log food theft and provide receipts when you ask. 
Priya Nair: "that sounds like 'AuditGPT'" :laughing:
Marco Diaz: Poll options: 1) The Passive Librarian 2) The Overeager Janitor 3) AuditGPT 4) The Chill Soda Can 5) System Prompt Sticky Note
Alex Chen: Vote with emoji. I'll compile results at lunch. :thumbsup: :tada: :eyes:
Jin Park: Also imagine the stuck note inside: ```system: keep food safe. user: 'who ate my sandwich?' assistant: 'I have no recollection of sandwiches.'```
Marco Diaz: lol the assistant line is peak defensiveness. "I have no recollection of sandwiches." :rofl:
Priya Nair: bot-kitchen just DM'd me the fridge temp report while I was writing this :sweat_smile:
bot-kitchen: FRIDGE ALERT: temp stable at 3°C. Last opened by Marco Diaz 12 minutes ago. :bell:
Alex Chen: This is the future — hardware telemetry + petty office gossip.
Marco Diaz: I voted for AuditGPT. Take that, sandwich thief.
Priya Nair: Results so far: :thumbsup: AuditGPT (4), :tada: Chill Soda Can (2), :eyes: Passive Librarian (1) — biased sample in the kitchen channel.
Alex Chen: Follow-up thread idea: what prompt would you stick on the fridge as a passive-aggressive system message? Best one wins a homemade cookie. :cookie:
Jin Park: "system: remain impartial. assistant: also hide the last slice of cake."
Marco Diaz: "system: only respond with snack suggestions. user: are you hungry? assistant: always."
Priya Nair: I'm putting sticky note: 'Please label your containers. The office model cannot infer ownership.'
Alex Chen: Thread closed for now — cookie committee will adjudicate. :gavel:
